summary.zh: 查询任意开源 GitHub 仓库的结构与文档
summary.en: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository

description.zh: Devin 团队的 DeepWiki 服务:对任意公开 GitHub 仓库提问,获取结构化的代码库讲解与文档检索。免费,无需账号。
description.en: DeepWiki by the Devin team: ask questions about any public GitHub repository and get structured codebase explanations. Free, no account needed.

summary.zh: 把最新的库文档与代码示例喂给智能体
summary.en: Up-to-date library docs and code examples for the agent

description.zh: Upstash 的 Context7:按需拉取各大框架/库的最新官方文档和示例,避免模型凭旧知识写出过期 API。免费使用。
description.en: Context7 by Upstash: fetches current official docs and examples for popular libraries on demand, so the agent stops writing outdated APIs. Free to use.

summary.zh: 检索微软官方文档与代码示例
summary.en: Search official Microsoft docs and code samples

description.zh: 微软官方 MCP 服务:实时检索 Microsoft Learn、Azure、.NET 等官方文档与代码示例,让回答有据可查。免费,无需账号。
description.en: Microsoft's official MCP server: real-time search over Microsoft Learn, Azure, and .NET documentation and code samples. Free, no account needed.

summary.zh: 检索 Cloudflare 开发者文档
summary.en: Search Cloudflare developer documentation

description.zh: Cloudflare 官方文档 MCP 服务:检索 Workers、R2、KV、Pages 等产品的最新开发者文档。免费,无需账号。
description.en: Cloudflare's official docs MCP server: search current developer documentation for Workers, R2, KV, Pages, and more. Free, no account needed.

summary.zh: 检索 AWS 官方文档与 API 参考
summary.en: Search AWS docs, API references, and guidance

description.zh: AWS 官方知识 MCP 服务:覆盖 AWS 全线文档、API 参考、What's New 与架构最佳实践。免费,无需 AWS 账号。
description.en: AWS's official knowledge MCP server: covers AWS documentation, API references, What's New posts, and architectural best practices. Free, no AWS account needed.

summary.zh: 检索模型、数据集、Space 与论文
summary.en: Search models, datasets, Spaces, and papers

description.zh: Hugging Face 官方 MCP 服务:检索 Hub 上的模型、数据集、Space 与每日论文,获取模型卡详情。匿名可用,免费。
description.en: Hugging Face's official MCP server: search models, datasets, Spaces, and daily papers on the Hub, and read model card details. Works anonymously, free.

summary.zh: 读写你的 Notion 页面与数据库
summary.en: Read and write your Notion pages and databases

description.zh: Notion 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以检索、创建和更新你的页面、数据库与评论。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Notion's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can search, create, and update your pages, databases, and comments.

summary.zh: 管理你的仓库、PR 和 issue
summary.en: Manage your repositories, PRs, and issues

description.zh: GitHub 官方远程 MCP 服务。智能体可以检索代码、管理 issue 和 PR、读取 CI 状态。使用你的 Personal Access Token 连接（github.com/settings/tokens 可创建）。
description.en: GitHub's official remote MCP server. The agent can search code, manage issues and PRs, and read CI status. Connects with your Personal Access Token (create one at github.com/settings/tokens).

summary.zh: 创建、查询和更新 Linear issue
summary.en: Create, query, and update Linear issues

description.zh: Linear 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以管理 issue、项目与周期,追踪团队进度。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Linear's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can manage issues, projects, and cycles.

summary.zh: 查询你项目的报错与性能问题
summary.en: Query errors and performance issues in your projects

description.zh: Sentry 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以检索 issue、读取堆栈与事件详情,辅助排障。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Sentry's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can search issues and read stack traces and event details.

summary.zh: 管理 Asana 任务与项目
summary.en: Manage Asana tasks and projects

description.zh: Asana 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以创建任务、更新状态、查询项目进展。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Asana's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can create tasks, update status, and query project progress.

summary.zh: 读写 Jira issue 与 Confluence 页面
summary.en: Work with Jira issues and Confluence pages

description.zh: Atlassian 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以检索、创建和更新 Jira issue 与 Confluence 页面。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Atlassian's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can search, create, and update Jira issues and Confluence pages.

summary.zh: 管理 monday.com 看板与条目
summary.en: Manage monday.com boards and items

description.zh: monday.com 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以创建和更新看板条目、写进展更新、查询团队数据。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: monday.com's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can create and update board items, post updates, and query team data.

summary.zh: 检索客服对话与客户数据
summary.en: Search support conversations and customer data

description.zh: Intercom 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以检索对话、联系人与工单,分析客服数据。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Intercom's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can search conversations, contacts, and tickets to analyze support data.

summary.zh: 管理 Stripe 支付、客户与商品
summary.en: Manage Stripe payments, customers, and products

description.zh: Stripe 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以创建支付链接、查询客户与订阅、检索 Stripe 文档。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Stripe's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can create payment links, query customers and subscriptions, and search Stripe docs.

summary.zh: 创建发票、查询交易与订单
summary.en: Create invoices, query transactions and orders

description.zh: PayPal 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以创建和发送发票、查询交易记录、管理订单。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: PayPal's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can create and send invoices, query transactions, and manage orders.

summary.zh: 管理 Square 商户的目录、订单与客户
summary.en: Manage Square catalog, orders, and customers

description.zh: Square 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以读写商品目录、订单、客户与支付数据。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Square's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can work with catalog, orders, customers, and payments data.

summary.zh: 把 Figma 设计稿变成代码上下文
summary.en: Turn Figma designs into code context

description.zh: 通过 Framelink 的 figma-developer-mcp 在本机运行，用个人访问令牌（PAT）读取设计稿结构、变量与图片资源，生成贴合设计的代码。（Figma 官方远程 MCP 的 OAuth 暂不接受第三方客户端注册，故走 PAT 方案。）
description.en: Runs Framelink's figma-developer-mcp locally with a personal access token (PAT) to read design structure, variables, and image assets. (Figma's official remote MCP currently rejects third-party OAuth client registration, hence the PAT route.)

summary.zh: 创建、填充与导出 Canva 设计
summary.en: Create, autofill, and export Canva designs

description.zh: Canva 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以生成设计、填充品牌模板、导出成品。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Canva's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can generate designs, autofill brand templates, and export results.

summary.zh: 管理 Webflow 站点与 CMS 内容
summary.en: Manage Webflow sites and CMS content

description.zh: Webflow 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以读写站点、页面与 CMS 集合内容。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Webflow's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can work with sites, pages, and CMS collection items.

summary.zh: 管理 Wix 站点、商店与 CRM
summary.en: Manage Wix sites, stores, and CRM

description.zh: Wix 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以管理站点内容、电商商品、订单与联系人。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Wix's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can manage site content, store products, orders, and contacts.

summary.zh: 查询部署、日志与项目配置
summary.en: Inspect deployments, logs, and project config

description.zh: Vercel 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以查询部署状态、读取构建日志、检索 Vercel 文档。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Vercel's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can inspect deployment status, read build logs, and search Vercel docs.

summary.zh: 部署与管理 Netlify 站点
summary.en: Deploy and manage Netlify sites

description.zh: Netlify 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以创建部署、管理站点与环境变量、读取构建日志。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Netlify's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can create deploys, manage sites and env vars, and read build logs.

summary.zh: 管理 Neon Postgres 并直接执行 SQL
summary.en: Manage Neon Postgres and run SQL directly

description.zh: Neon 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以管理项目与数据库分支、执行 SQL、做安全的模式迁移。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Neon's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can manage projects and branches, run SQL, and perform safe schema migrations.

summary.zh: 从全球数百个节点发起网络测量
summary.en: Run network measurements from hundreds of global probes

description.zh: jsDelivr 的 Globalping MCP 服务:从全球节点执行 ping、traceroute、DNS、HTTP 测量,定位网络问题。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Globalping by jsDelivr: run ping, traceroute, DNS, and HTTP measurements from probes around the world to diagnose network issues.

summary.zh: 调用数千个现成爬虫抓取网页数据
summary.en: Run thousands of ready-made scrapers

description.zh: Apify 官方 MCP 服务。授权后智能体可以搜索并调用 Apify 平台上的现成 Actor,抓取社交、电商、地图等站点数据。首次连接会打开浏览器完成授权。
description.en: Apify's official MCP server. After authorization the agent can search and call ready-made Actors to scrape social, e-commerce, and map sites.

summary.zh: 让智能体驱动一个真实浏览器
summary.en: Let the agent drive a real browser

description.zh: 微软官方 Playwright MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):打开网页、点击、填表、截图。基于无障碍树而非视觉模型,快且稳。
description.en: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP (runs locally via npx): navigate, click, fill forms, and screenshot. Accessibility-tree based, fast and deterministic.

summary.zh: 用 DevTools 调试网页:控制台、网络、性能
summary.en: Debug pages with DevTools: console, network, performance

description.zh: Chrome 团队官方 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):驱动 Chrome 读取控制台与网络请求、录制性能追踪、自动化页面操作。
description.en: The Chrome team's official MCP (runs locally via npx): drive Chrome to read console and network activity, record performance traces, and automate pages.

summary.zh: 给智能体一块结构化思考的草稿纸
summary.en: A structured scratchpad for multi-step reasoning

description.zh: MCP 官方参考服务(本机通过 npx 运行):把复杂问题拆成可修订、可分支的思考步骤,提升多步推理的稳定性。
description.en: An official MCP reference server (runs locally via npx): break complex problems into revisable, branchable thinking steps for steadier multi-step reasoning.

summary.zh: 检索 Shopify 开发文档与 API schema
summary.en: Search Shopify dev docs and API schemas

description.zh: Shopify 官方开发者 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):检索 shopify.dev 文档、内省 Admin GraphQL schema,辅助开发 Shopify 应用。
description.en: Shopify's official developer MCP (runs locally via npx): search shopify.dev docs and introspect the Admin GraphQL schema.

summary.zh: 查询任意时区时间并做换算
summary.en: Current time in any timezone, with conversion

description.zh: MCP 官方参考服务(本机通过 uvx 运行):查询任意时区的当前时间,做跨时区换算。
description.en: An official MCP reference server (runs locally via uvx): get the current time in any timezone and convert between timezones.

summary.zh: 抓取网页并转成 Markdown
summary.en: Fetch a web page as Markdown

description.zh: MCP 官方参考服务(本机通过 uvx 运行):抓取指定 URL 的网页内容并转换为便于模型阅读的 Markdown。
description.en: An official MCP reference server (runs locally via uvx): fetch a URL and convert the page into model-friendly Markdown.

summary.zh: 独立索引的网页、新闻与图片搜索
summary.en: Web, news, and image search on an independent index

description.zh: Brave 官方 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):基于 Brave 独立索引的网页、新闻、图片、视频与本地搜索。需要 Brave Search API key,有免费额度。
description.en: Brave's official MCP (runs locally via npx): web, news, image, video, and local search on Brave's independent index. Requires a Brave Search API key; free tier available.

summary.zh: 为智能体而生的搜索与网页提取
summary.en: Search and extraction built for agents

description.zh: Tavily 官方 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):面向 AI 智能体优化的实时搜索、网页提取与站点爬取。需要 Tavily API key,有免费额度。
description.en: Tavily's official MCP (runs locally via npx): real-time search, page extraction, and site crawling optimized for AI agents. Requires a Tavily API key; free tier available.

summary.zh: 语义搜索:网页、论文、公司与代码
summary.en: Semantic search: pages, papers, companies, code

description.zh: Exa 官方 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):神经检索驱动的网页搜索、公司研究、论文与代码查找。需要 Exa API key,有免费额度。
description.en: Exa's official MCP (runs locally via npx): neural search over the web, company research, papers, and code. Requires an Exa API key; free tier available.

summary.zh: 无广告高质量搜索与页面摘要
summary.en: Ad-free premium search and summarization

description.zh: Kagi 官方 MCP(本机通过 uvx 运行):调用 Kagi 的无广告搜索与 Universal Summarizer。需要 Kagi API key(付费服务)。
description.en: Kagi's official MCP (runs locally via uvx): ad-free search and the Universal Summarizer. Requires a Kagi API key (paid service).

summary.zh: 强力网页抓取:整站爬取与结构化提取
summary.en: Powerful scraping: site crawls and structured extraction

description.zh: Firecrawl 的本地 MCP 服务(在你的电脑上通过 npx 运行)。提供整站爬取、批量抓取、结构化提取等能力。需要 Firecrawl API key。
description.en: Firecrawl's local MCP server (runs on your machine via npx). Site crawling, batch scraping, and structured extraction. Requires a Firecrawl API key.

summary.zh: 管理 Supabase 项目:建表、跑 SQL、看日志
summary.en: Manage Supabase: tables, SQL, logs

description.zh: Supabase 官方 MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):管理项目与数据库、执行 SQL、查询日志与生成类型。需要 Personal Access Token。
description.en: Supabase's official MCP (runs locally via npx): manage projects and databases, run SQL, read logs, and generate types. Requires a personal access token.

summary.zh: 读写 Airtable 表格与记录
summary.en: Read and write Airtable bases and records

description.zh: 社区维护的 Airtable MCP(本机通过 npx 运行):检索、创建和更新 base、表与记录。需要 Airtable personal access token。
description.en: A community-maintained Airtable MCP (runs locally via npx): search, create, and update bases, tables, and records. Requires an Airtable personal access token.

summary.zh: 文字转语音、转录与音频处理
summary.en: Text-to-speech, transcription, and audio tools

description.zh: ElevenLabs 官方 MCP(本机通过 uvx 运行):文字转语音、语音克隆、音频转录与变声。需要 ElevenLabs API key,有免费额度。
description.en: ElevenLabs' official MCP (runs locally via uvx): text-to-speech, voice cloning, transcription, and voice changing. Requires an ElevenLabs API key; free tier available.
